## Activity

During November 2024, Central Eye Clinic recorded 224 captures. Activity was completed in line with the planned service arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity indicates that the clinic maintained regular image capture throughout the month, with no reported disruption to the scheduled sessions. The total of 224 captures provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 224 captures, 5 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.2 per cent. The result indicates that most images were suitable for review. The ungradable images should continue to be monitored through routine quality assurance, with any recurring issues considered as part of normal service review.

## Grading

Grading identified 64 referable results from the November 2024 activity. The median lag between capture and grading was 7 days. This measure should be reviewed alongside local workflow arrangements to support timely assessment and follow-up. Overall, the month’s activity records the volume of captures, the proportion that could not be graded, and the number of referable results processed through the service.
